description: As-maintained manufacturing bill of materials (mBOM) tracking serialized structural fasteners, metallurgy specifications, depot installation hours, and allowable discard tolerances.

fields.name: mbom_record_id
fields.description: Primary Key (PK): Serialized fastener assembly record identifier (e.g., MBOM-ZM151-F496-H14).

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Foreign Key (FK -> airframe_component_telemetry.tail_number, Cluster Key): Aircraft tail number where the fastener is installed (e.g., ZM151).

fields.name: station_id
fields.description: Cluster Key: Precise airframe coordinate and hole number (e.g., 'Frame 496 — Fastener Hole #14').

fields.name: fastener_material_spec
fields.description: High-strength aerospace fastener metallurgy specification (e.g., 'Ti-6Al-4V' / Titanium Ti-6Al-4V per AMS 4928 / AMS 4967).

fields.name: fastener_lot_number
fields.description: Cluster Key / Index: Manufacturing batch and heat-treatment lot number (e.g., 'Lot #8841-B') tracked for fleet-wide containment.

fields.name: hours_since_install
fields.description: Unit: flight hours (hrs). Accumulated flight hours on this fastener since depot installation (e.g., 312.0 hrs).

fields.name: allowable_elongation_in
fields.description: Unit: inches (in). SRM Chapter 51-40 maximum allowable shear elongation discard threshold (e.g., 0.015 in).

fields.name: measured_ndi_elongation_in
fields.description: Unit: inches (in). Actual measured elongation (e.g., 0.012 in) derived from multimodal C-scan vision extraction and CAD spatial join.

fields.name: global_fleet_affected_count
fields.description: Unit: aircraft count. Total number of allied F-35 airframes globally fitted with fasteners from this manufacturing batch (e.g., 14 aircraft).
